I do not feel it made me show less lines but my skin does feel improved and healthier.

avis.titre: Great serum that can help tighten skin
avis.texte: I was given the Lancôme Longevity MD Intercept Serum in exchange for my honest review, and I have to say, I really love this product. At first, I was a little skeptical, but the longer I used it, the more I noticed a difference in my skin. The serum has a lightweight, milky texture that glides on smoothly and absorbs well. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated, moisturized, and refreshed. I like to apply it using gentle upward motions for the best results. With continued use, my skin feels firmer, smoother, and more radiant. I've also noticed that it helps improve the appearance of fine lines and gives my skin a more youthful look. This is definitely a product I plan to keep using because the results have impressed me so far.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum worked pretty well. I used it twice a day for a month. My face felt smoother and hydrated. The scent was a bit strong but pleasant. I like how sturdy the bottle is but hated the pump. It did not consistently pump out the same amount. Otherwise it's a good serum.

avis.titre: Ok but made my skin react adversely
avis.texte: I haven't had enough of an opportunity to test the product to see results but the few times I've used it it made my skin very dry. I know this is usually the result when you start using a new product so I'll continue to try and utilize it. There is very little scent and it absorbs rather quickly. Wouldn't say it's ideal for sensitive skin without building up a tolerance first. Patch test for sure.

avis.titre: Absolutely Sophisticated- L'Éclat in a Bottle
avis.texte: I received this product as a gift in return for my honest opinion. This serum from Lancôme is luxuriously rich and velvety. It's a silky and supple fluid that effortlessly glides across the skin, leaving it wrapped in a veil of pure softness and deep cushiony hydration. My skin is left with a beautiful luminous glow that feels deeply nourishing. It sank into my skin weightlessly, giving it a gorgeous radiance. I have been using it now for several weeks and my skin looks renewed and glowing. This formula was perfect for my tired dull skin. I use it after a cleanser and toner before my moisturizer day and night. Packed with Mitopure postbiotics and peptides, this serum has proven to be what my skin needed for to boost it's firmness and radiance. I love knowing the science behind it, the Mitopure postpiotic actually help renew skin cells so that my skin has a truly lit from with in glow.

avis.titre: I wanted to love it but…..
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I recently tried the Lancôme Absolue ßx Intercept The Serum, and I really wanted to love it, but unfortunately, my skin didn't agree with it. After only a couple of uses, I broke out in hives, which I suspect may be due to vitamin C in its formula. While the serum is marketed for anti-aging benefits and promises a luxurious treatment with advanced ingredients like minospure and longevity actives, the reaction was too severe for me to continue using it. For the high price point, I personally don't think it's worth it, at least for sensitive skin like mine. I can see how it might be effective for others, but my experience wasn't positive. If you have reactive skin or a history of sensitivity to vitamin C, I would recommend patch testing first before splurging on this serum. Rating: 2/5 – Lovely packaging and concept, but not suitable for my skin.

avis.titre: Lancôme Intercept: Lightweight Hydration & Lasting Softness
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoyed the consistency of the Lancôme Intercept the serum. It's a serum an off white milky color stands out from other serums I've used in that this one intially applies like a cream. I have dry skin and when I'm in rush I'll the Lancôme Intercept instead of my regular moisturizer and it helps with my skin's dryness. It does have a scent but I'm not offended by it, it's not overwhelming. It's florally, powdery, a hint of sweetness or freshness. It does absorb rapidly into the skin after application, I think that is due to the alcohols in the formulation. My skin wasn't affected by the alcohol in the formula, it felt smooth and soft with a slight glow. I used the product for a month and my skin never felt dry.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried this serum of and on for over a month before I realized it was causing a reaction. My usual routine is: Am- niacinamide and vitamin c serums, moisturizer, and sunscreen. Pm- retinol 3x week and moisturizer. Initially I tried this serum in the morning in place of my usual niacinamide serum. My fave felt sensitive after the first day and sensitive and bumpy after the second. At this point I took a break for a few days. Next, I tried it in the evening on non retinol days. Same result: sensitive, bumpy skin after a couple uses. I had to take a break and cut out all actives for a week before my skin felt normal. I tried using it once more but had to wash my face within minutes because it was red, bumpy and irritated. Usually, when I have a product that I cannot use on my fave I can at least use it on the body. However, this is unfortunately not one of those products. When I tried it in the back of my hand I had a similar reaction within 30 minutes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Can we just talk about how perfect the consistency of this serum is. I really enjoy this serum, and Lancome is notoriously high quality, so I'm hoping for amazing results!

avis.titre: Silky, lightweight, and a beautiful addition to my routine
avis.texte: I have been using the Lancôme Paris Longevity MD Intercept Serum for a little over two weeks now, and I'm really enjoying it. The first thing I noticed was the silky texture. It glides onto the skin effortlessly and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. The scent is light and luxurious, giving it that high-end skincare experience without being overpowering. The packaging is also beautiful and elegant, which is exactly what I expect from Lancôme. It looks lovely sitting on my vanity. After more than 15 days of use, my skin feel softer, smoother, and better hydrated. Well, I know skin care results take time, I do feel like my skin looks healthier and more refreshed overall. I especially appreciate that it's lightweight enough to fit into both my morning and nighttime routine routines without piling under other products or makeup. A little goes along way, and my skin feels comfortable and nourished after every application. Overall, the serum feels like a luxury product that delivers a lively user experience, and I'm excited excited to continue using it.
